title: Topic 6.5: Trade and Finance in Islam

pages.lesson:
LESSON: TRADE AND FINANCE IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.5: Trade and Finance in Islam
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Trade and Finance in Islam, part of Muamalat (Social Relations) in Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why should Muslims observe the rules of borrowing and lending money?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss the rules of borrowing and lending money in groups and make a class presentation,

2. visit an Islamic financial institution to learn more about borrowing and lending money and make notes,

3. listen to a resource person from consumer protection agencies to enlighten on consumer rights with regards to borrowing and lending money,

4. role play borrowing and lending money while observing the rules.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the rules of borrowing and lending money in groups and make a class presentation,
2. visit an Islamic financial institution to learn more about borrowing and lending money and make notes,
3. listen to a resource person from consumer protection agencies to enlighten on consumer rights with regards to borrowing and lending money,
4. role play borrowing and lending money while observing the rules.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Trade and Finance in Islam together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: the skill of seeking advice on information and support is enhanced as learners visit an Islamic

financial institution to learn more about borrowing and lending money.

• Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening and speaking enhanced when learners discuss the rules

of borrowing and lending money in groups and make a class presentation.

35

• Critical thinking and Problem-solving: the skill of active listening and communication enhanced as learners listen

to a resource person from consumer protection agencies on consumer rights with regards to borrowing and

lending money.

● Creativity and Imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners role-play borrowing and lending money while

observing the rules.

Values:
• Integrity is enhanced as learners research on the rules of borrowing and lending money.

• Responsibility is enhanced as learners discuss the rules of borrowing and lending money in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Integrity as learners research on the rules of borrowing and lending money.

● Financial Literacy as learners visit an Islamic financial institution to learn more about borrowing and lending money and

make notes and listen to a resource person from consumer protection agencies on consumer rights with regards to

borrowing and lending money.

from consumer protection agencies.
